HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
